ITEM 1 | Halved and whole strawberries, bright red with white core areas visible on cut faces, glossy and moist, sitting in a cluster on the lower left of the plate, pieces roughly 1.5 to 3 cm across, covering about 12% of plate surface, piled to about 1.5 cm high | 75
ITEM 2 | Blackberries, dark purple-black, drupelet texture visible, matte with slight sheen, clustered in the lower center and right of the plate, individual berries about 1.5 to 2 cm across, covering about 8% of plate surface, mounded about 1 cm high | 45
ITEM 3 | Blueberries, dark blue with dusty bloom, smooth round shape, scattered in small groups across the center and right of the plate, each about 1 to 1.5 cm across, covering about 5% of plate surface, about 1 cm high | 25
ITEM 4 | Whole and sliced strawberries, red with slight sheen, scattered in the upper right area of the plate near the blackberries and blueberries, pieces about 2 to 3 cm, covering about 6% of plate surface, about 1 cm high | 30
